title: Parachute Rigger Sources Sought
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > USMC > MARCORP I&L > MARINE CORPS INSTALLATIONS COMMAND > MCIWEST > COMMANDING GENERAL

files.name: Performance Work Statement(PWS)_TORDS Parachute Rigger Support.pdf

description:
The Contractor shall provide FAA-certificated parachute rigger personnel, parachute packing, maintenance, inspection, and logistics support to Reconnaissance Training Company, Detachment Yuma Proving Ground (YPG) – Advanced Mobile Training Team (AMTT), Advanced Infantry Training Battalion, School of Infantry (West), in support of TORDS-E/P training in accordance with Marine Corps Order (MCO) 3120.11A. 
Services include on-site parachute rigging, packing, and direct flight-line support during scheduled Training Iterations at drop zones nationwide, as well as off-site reserve parachute repacking and main canopy relines conducted at the Contractor's commercial facility.
